name: Cookie Build
description:
Cookie Build is a Minecraft Pocket Edition minigame server. There is only SkyWars, MicroBattles, Build Battle and Turf Wars available right now, but thanks to your support more mini games are coming soon.

You can have some IPs on our website or all IPs on our Android app :

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=cookiebuild.com.cookiebuildstatus

Have fun !
